stem: Based on paragraphs 7 through 9, why might people assume that food forests are a “spin-off” of community gardens?

options.label: F
options.text: They both feature crops that do not need much maintenance over time.

options.label: G
options.text: They both provide crops that are shared with local food banks.

options.label: H
options.text: They both offer residents public areas to harvest food.

options.label: J
options.text: They both require residents to make a monetary investment.
